name: A 20-year-old game is being remade with the newest engine RPG MAKER UNITE and distributed for free? ~RPG Maker's heroes vs. the demon king~
name_original: A 20-year-old game is being remade with the newest engine RPG MAKER UNITE and distributed for free? ~RPG Maker's heroes vs. the demon king~
description:
◆The legendary stupid game from 20 years ago has been superbly remade with the Demon King as the main character!(←the story setting, but it's true that RPG MAKER UNITE was made!)

The legendary stupid game that was created 20 years ago using RPG MAKER 2000 has made a surprising comeback in the latest RPG MAKER UNITE! However, it doesn't end with just a remake - this time the main character is the Demon King!

The heroes who have colored the history of RPG Maker have gathered together, transcending the boundaries of time and work, and have launched a furious invasion of the Demon King's castle!

The player will be fighting them off as the Demon King.

Can you withstand the onslaught of the heroes and protect the dignity of the Demon King's army?

◆ The genre is a surprising tower defense x shooting game!

This is a tower defense shooting game that uses RPG MAKER UNITE and makes use of Unity's functions!

Defeat the heroes who attack one after another by making full use of magic, traps, and even the Demon King's army of monsters!

Make the monsters your allies and build the strongest formation!

Use the shooting element to attack and defeat the heroes!

The heroes will attack you using their unique skills and equipment. Form your own strategy depending on the monsters you have, and defeat the heroes who attack you one after another!

◆ Be sure to check the treasure chests on the map!

When we think of adventure, we think of treasure chests.

However, the treasure chests in this game are not so simple!

What... is that comment from that person...?

requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
OS: Windows 10 / 11
Processor: Intel Core i5
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Compatible OpenGL
Storage: 4 GB available space
